inputs.label: CarnEvil v1.0.3 arcade set (carnevil.zip)
inputs.help: Your own carnevil.zip, with carnevil1_9.u32, sound102.u95 and 486_carnevil.u96 inside. Leave it zipped.

inputs.label: CarnEvil disc image (carnevil.chd)
inputs.help: The CHD that matches your CarnEvil v1.0.3 set.

steps.why: The guide has the user grant file access on the setup screen.

steps.text: Open CarnEvil VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for file access, allow it. Keep the Touch controllers awake while it starts.

notes: No BIOS is needed. The release also has a PCVR zip and a source zip.
